narrative.overview: A quiet, dense reference surface: gray neutrals, one accent, system fonts, a three-column frame (tree, document, outline). Every page is complete without scripts; search, the lazy tree, filters, copy and display settings are enhancements.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral ramp with one accent per theme
System font stacks; monospace only for code and identifiers
Navigation tree with bounded server window
Native dialogs for search and display settings
rules: One accent rule: no new hues for emphasis
dos: Reuse shared roles across all eight themes
Keep signatures complete; wrap, never clip
Keep every page complete without scripts
donts: No web fonts, CDN assets, inline styles or inline scripts
No card elevation on rows or prose
